'''Home Fleet Strike Group Five''' was one of the defense fleets stationed at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Composition==
Led by [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]], it consisted of three [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]]&mdash;[[Integrity (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Integrity'']], [[Indomitable (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Indomitable'']], and ''[[Perseverance/Legends|Perseverance]]''&mdash;with the support of the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class cruiser]] ''[[Mas Ramdar/Legends|Mas Ramdar]]''.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

==History==
The strike group participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|fleet]]. During the final stages of the battle, Strike Group Five deployed in a triangle around the ''Mas Ramdar'', and attacked the Separatist [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] with full force.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

As a result, the ''Mas Ramdar'' was blown to bits, and the ''Indomitable'' became a mere shell. All that remained were the ''Integrity'' and the ''Perseverance''. The Strike Group trapped the ''Invisible Hand'', with Needa ordering [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] surrender. The General refused, and the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] subsequently damaged the ''Invisible Hand'' critically&mdash;damage which ultimately led to her demise. Because of a communication error, the group also inadvertently nearly killed Palpatine, as well as the two Jedi who rescued him, in the process.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />
